Bring salted water with lemon slices to the boil and fill a bowl with iced water.Poach the prawns, then plunge into the iced water.Peel the prawns.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce and serve the prawns on crushed ice.Spanish expedition olivesGreen and kalamata olives marinated in orange peel, garlic and chilliHow to make it150g green olives150g kalamata olives1 orange2 garlic cloves1 pinch chilli flakes3 tbsp olive oil200g manchegoPeel strips of orange zest and slice the garlic.Toss the olives with zest, garlic, chilli and oil.Leave to marinate.Serve with thin wedges of manchego.MainsQueen Anne's Revenge paellaChicken thighs, chorizo, capsicum and saffron rice, simmered without stirringHow to make it400g chicken thighs1 chorizo1 brown onion1 red capsicum300g paella rice1 pinch saffron2 tsp smoked paprika900ml chicken stock300g green prawns500g mussels2 tbsp olive oilSlice the chorizo, onion and capsicum and scrub the mussels.Brown the chicken and chorizo in the olive oil in a wide pan, then add the onion and capsicum.Add the rice, saffron, paprika and stock and simmer without stirring.Add the prawns and mussels and cover until the mussels open.Jungle island pulled jerk porkThe jungle island with the Fountain of YouthHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork shoulder rubbed with jerk spices, slow cooked at 150°C for 4 hours, pulled with rice and beans.Blitz 4 spring onions, 2 scotch bonnet or red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme leaves, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp soy and the juice of 2 limes into a paste.Rub over a 1.5kg pork shoulder and marinate overnight.Roast covered at 150°C for 4 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the juices.Simmer 1.5 cups rice with a tin of drained kidney beans, 400ml coconut milk and water for 18 minutes and serve together.SweetsCustard cream puffsChoux puffs filled with custard folded with whipped creamHow to make it100g butter250ml water150g plain flour4 eggs250ml custard300ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugarHeat the oven to 200°C. Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour, cool slightly, then beat in the eggs.Pipe small mounds onto lined trays and bake.Cool completely.Whip the cream and fold into the custard.Fill each puff and dust with icing sugar.DrinksFountain of Youth rum punchWhite rum, coconut water, pineapple and lime over crushed iceHow to make it160ml white rum550ml coconut water300ml pineapple juice2 limes2 tbsp sugar syrup1 bag crushed ice1 pinch ground nutmeg1/4 pineappleJuice the limes and cut the pineapple into wedges.Mix the rum, coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice and syrup in a jug.Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour in the punch.Grate nutmeg over the top and add a pineapple wedge.
